snippet.title: Shogo M.A.D. VR mod Preview
snippet.description:
Hi there folks, 
I've been cooking this one on and off for a bit in my spare time as a fun side project. I am excited to finally share a small proof of concept of it!

First off, I LOVE Shogo. I have such a huge soft spot for this quirky game. Shogo has always been in my opinion incredibly underappreciated. I had been heavily inspired by other oldschool flatscreen game to VR conversion projects like that awesome new Fear VR mod, Half Life 2 VR and QuakeVR. I really wanted to give Shogo the same sort of treatment.

There are quite a few things that I want to make sure are neat and tidy before fully releasing this. IMO cookie dough is good, but when it's baked it is even better. Both it and I just need a bit more time :) A couple major ongoing bugs of note, it is prone to the odd crash here and there, the audio will sometimes cut out randomly, there are a few weird interactions with transforming as a mech and so on

Stay tuned my friends!

https://github.com/BrandonW24/Shogo-VR
